observed_chain: Actual constructor registers entity/block/item registries; TRIOPS is WATER_AMBIENT and uses WaterAnimal placement helper. Reproduction is a separate pathway; these methods do not call NaturalSpawner cap admission, but this is no proof of universal engine or cross-mod cap bypass or installed biome availability.

Registered CreatureAITargetItems selects nonempty age>10 targetable items, nearest squared distance in radius9 cube centered mob position plus(0.5,0.5,0.5). canUse has worldtime/random/noAction/passenger/hand gates, not exact10tick periodic service. At squared distance<default2 and empty main hand it calls onGetItem then unconditionally shrinks1 and stops; no sink recheck of canTargetItem, owner, pickup delay or callback feeding success. Navigation booleans ignored.

Dropped callback requests EAT/sound/heal5 only for edible nonnull-food items and sets fed on server only at cooldown==0 and !fed. Fixed larva registration is plain Item(Properties), whose native baseline foodProperties=null; targeting and item shrink do not imply successful feeding. Player route separately requests heal/EAT without edible guard. Declared breed tag carrot/nested forge crop tag is not loaded tag evidence.

Player branch captures hand stack then calls super; only if super did not consume and target qualifies it shrinks noncreative stack before breed-tag check. Native count<=0 makes getItem AIR and tag lookup uses that item. Count1 noncreative qualified carrot plus loaded tag excluding AIR therefore fails post-shrink carrot identity. This is a conditional source-order inference, not reproduced item-loss gameplay. Player fed assignment lies outside cooldown/server guard; the heart event is guarded.

Breed canUse checks own water/fed/cooldown/own breedWith null, then cooled-down bounded-area nearest mate selection. Mate predicate checks other identity, alive/water/fed/cooldown, not pregnancy/baby/reservation. It writes selected partner.breedWith=self but not own reciprocal field. Continuation separately rejects both pregnancies and own reserved state. Close-range tick marks only initiator pregnant. Goal.stop clears initiator food and gives1200..4799 cooldown even without successful pregnancy; no reservation cleanup is shown. Reserved partners remain selectable, so this is not proof all pairing deadlocks.

Own NBT and TriopsTag bucket helper save pregnancy, fed/cooldown/scale/baby age; live breedWith and goal partner not serialized. Pregnancy is absent from both custom persistence and removeWhenFarAway exemptions. A plain adult pregnant initiator after stop may enter the native nonpersistent despawn branch if no other exemption, not inevitably disappear.

LayEgg canUse requires pregnancy plus random1/30 evaluation; at most10 XZ[-5,4] samples fromY+10 descending through below-air. Selected position is air over water-tag; continuation rechecks only egg position air. Within squared distance2 it clears pregnancy before setBlockAndUpdate and ignores the returned boolean. No pregnancy restoration on failed placement is shown.

Full native Frogspawn parent schedules this block via onPlace with nextInt(min,max), baseline3600 inclusive to12000 exclusive, mutable testing defaults. Survival needs exact Fluids.WATER below and Fluids.EMPTY at egg, stricter than placement water-tag. updateShape may return AIR and falling-block entityInside requests destruction. Source scheduling request is not actual loaded scheduler delivery or successful egg persistence.

Triops egg override, after inherited survival and water-tag guard, calls destroyBlock(false) first and ignores its result, then makes2or3 create attempts. Nonnull entities receive raw x/z andY-.5, yaw1..360, persistenceRequired andBabyAge=-12000 before unchecked addFreshEntity. No finalizeSpawn, placement/obstruction check, success-committed retained egg or retry appears here. Calls/attempts do not prove removal or offspring count; vanilla private tadpole hatch/sound path is not called by override.

Complete entity tick decrements positive breedCooldown but does not advance BabyAge; immediate WaterAnimal/PathfinderMob are not AgeableMob. No runtime forever-baby conclusion. Native Mob.checkDespawn puts Forge canEntityDespawn and distance checks together under !persistenceRequired&&!requiresCustomPersistence. Explicit persistenceRequired skips both, not just distance. The earlier peaceful conditional remains structurally prior; shown Mob default returnsfalse and WaterAnimal does not override it. No universal immunity to arbitrary external removal is established.

proposal_corrections_and_limits.correction: Replace success wording with calls destroyBlock first, ignores result. Source does not establish successful destruction before unchecked add attempts.

Forge canEntityDespawn shown at Mob712 is inside skipped nonpersistent branch. Do not imply that this event still runs for persistenceRequired offspring. Prior peaceful branch is conditional with false default here. Other external removal remains unexamined.
canTargetItem used for candidate selection is not freshly rechecked at item consumption sink; callback success is not checked. This does not prove runtime stale-target failure.
Local official-mapped Forge1.20.1 sources archive is the authority for these native bytes, not another mod Git tree or an executed upstream installation.

世界唯一栖息chunk的确定性搜索与持久放弃；不是两只活体互动引发的繁殖状态转换。
有效结构start/piece和conquest决定候选出生表；不是动物繁殖到卵方块的生命周期。
Hydra世界生成地表角点和共享危险点间距，直接尝试生成实体；不存在配对或独立卵方块延迟。
海岛支撑/空间检查后的世界生成cohort；不是食物资格、配对旗标、妊娠、放卵再孵化。
海床heightmap偏移水点的feature直接add且false返回；不是已存在活体的繁殖事件。
共享自然出生predicate与biome名单/维度/地块/sky/structure_set交集；繁殖的已喂食配对及卵调度不是该谓词机制的参数变体。
FunctionalSpawnerData经原生返回值AND环境函数筛选，保留原失败；本链不替换或筛选NaturalSpawner返回值。
结构firepit postProcess的有界cohort及home持久状态；与活体配对后放世界卵不同。旧NeoForge事件次序不能套用到当前Forge父类。
活蚁转巢内NBT队列、占巢计时、add成功才移除队列项；Triops是两只活体不对称配对、妊娠放独立世界卵，先请求销毁卵再不检查add结果，没有成功提交保留队列。延迟/持久化共性不构成重复，二者也不拆成多个案例。
另一实体FinalizeSpawn附属遭遇，按当前商人乘客的剩余寿命同步退出，驯服退出回收；没有动物食物配对、妊娠或卵方块调度。
地下噪声列找非solid层/地板/墙和旋转锚点后添加结构piece；不是繁殖链，无新的建筑信用。
已种植个体在饥饿成长平台消耗肉并在阈值换成成人实体，旧实体随后discard；没有另一个活体配对、妊娠与独立世界卵，不能把相同食物/持久字段计第二项。
寄生brood旗标与宿主sting效果、宿主消失DENY和效果到期产生后代；Triops不依赖宿主效果，依赖配对/自存妊娠、世界卵严格水流体存活及原生onPlace调度。延迟后代和生命周期缺陷属共性，整链只建议1。

decision_rationale: One distinct whole implementation family: asymmetric fed-pair acquisition through persisted own pregnancy to water-surface world egg and inherited scheduled persistent offspring attempts. Delayed spawn/persistence alone is not claimed novel. Food tags, parent methods, registry lines, pair stop, placement failure, egg survival, two-or-three loop, hashes and age flags are supporting observations, not extra credits. Recommend at most1 after coordinator integration of corrections; no accepted EA number assigned here.
